text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic alert fired: canary-eu-west-3 / llm-inference-latency > 250ms (rolling p95=612ms). Auto-page to oncall-sre and paged escalation policy.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P-210123 - HIGH - Canary probe failure (canary-eu-west-3). Triggered by synthetic-runner.
Lin (oncall-sre): ack P-210123 — on my way, joining Zoom. first glance: huge p95 spike across all canary shards in eu-west-3.
Maya (eng-runtime): I see latency + socket timeout churn in runtime metrics. Logs show GPU host pool returning 503s to router for a brief window.
Carlos (platform): Any config or autoscaler activity? Checking recent infra events... there was an instance pool scaling down 3m before alert (k8s-scaler event: scale-to-0->2).
Lin (oncall-sre): Hm, autoscaler looks like it aggressively removed nodes while a background rollout was running. Could be a noisy draining sequence.
Signe (support): No direct customer tickets yet, but Webhooks has a slight uptick in 500s in eu-west. If it becomes customer-impacting we'll need comms.
Maya (eng-runtime): Dumping recent router logs and KV-cache misses. Attaching quick snippet:
```
2026-03-14T20:07:12Z router-3 WARN downstream 503 service-unavailable connection-reset
2026-03-14T20:07:13Z runtime-12 ERROR model-infer timeout seq=1 len=512
2026-03-14T20:07:14Z autoscaler INFO draining node node-57 evicting 42 pods
```
Carlos (platform): I applied a temporary scale-up: added 4 hot nodes to eu-west-3 pool (manual override) — will monitor.
Lin (oncall-sre): Good. I'm going to mute the noisy synthetic to stop paging while we stabilize: `/incidents mute canary-eu-west-3 10m reason="investigating autoscaler-induced drain"`
incident-bot: Action recorded. canary-eu-west-3 muted for 10 minutes by Lin.
Maya (eng-runtime): After the manual scale-up the router error rate dropped immediately, p95 back to ~120ms. Looks like capacity collapse during drain caused backpressure and kernel timeouts.
Lin (oncall-sre): Marking P-210123 as mitigated. We're keeping it open for postmortem.
Signe (support): Notifying CS triage: "Potential brief degradation in eu-west-3 around 20:07 UTC, patched; reaching out if customers report issues."
Carlos (platform): Scheduling a follow-up: change autoscaler cooldown from 30s -> 180s for eu pools to avoid rapid scale-down during rollouts. Will propose in infra-ops RFC.
Maya (eng-runtime): Notes for postmortem: 1) autoscaler drained too aggressively during rolling node update 2) router didn't soft-failfast to fallback model variant 3) synthetic paging threshold too tight for transient drains.
Lin (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm off shift in 25 minutes — handing to Maya to lead postmortem and timeline. Maya, please own the follow-up and ping infra-ops.
Maya (eng-runtime): Got it. I'll run a root-cause runbook, collect kernel traces and container drain logs, and draft a short blameless postmortem. ETA for draft: 6 hours.
Signe (support): I'll update the customer-facing notes template once postmortem draft is available.
Lin (oncall-sre): Closing the immediate page. If the synthetic un-mutes and re-fires, PGD will re-escalate. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
